_comment: Single source of truth for the look (RESEARCH_BRIEF.md §1.2–1.3). Nothing is styled per video. Change a value here, re-run `npm run check` and `npm run contact-sheet`, and approve the new snapshots on purpose.

colors._comment: Neutrals: ink, paper, white. Accents: signature (the stickman's tie ONLY), money, loss, highlight. Never add a color without updating docs/STYLE_GUIDE.md.

scale._comment: 1 head unit (HU) = the stickman's head height. All characters and props are sized in HU and drawn at this one scale. 128 px → the stickman is ~650 px tall (owner: bigger).

wobble._comment: Hand-drawn line character. segmentPx = resample spacing, wavelengthPx = distance between noise peaks, overshootPx = max extension of straight line ends.

boil._comment: Line boil: wobble is re-seeded `fps` times per second (animating on twos at 30 fps would be 15; we use 10 = on threes).

fonts._comment: All SIL Open Font License. Files live in assets/fonts/. Owner likes Anton everywhere for now.

layout._comment: Owner 2026-10-31: stock photo panel on top, big character stage below with the caption band at its top. Safe-zone values are common creator guidance, NOT verified against the current TikTok UI (brief TODO).

stage._comment: Character blocking: moving between marks, hops, tilts and the rare spin (owner: he should move locations and sometimes rotate).

captions._comment: Short phrase groups, not single words (owner: 180 WPM is too fast for one word at a time, and up to 7 words felt too slow). Active word highlighted.

stock._comment: Licensed stock photos in the top panel (brief §1.7). One house treatment for every photo.
